name: Easy2Hard-Bench
description: Easy2Hard-Bench is a standardized collection of six benchmark datasets across domains such as mathematics, programming, chess, and reasoning, annotated with fine-grained numerical difficulty scores to profile LLM performance and generalization from easy to hard problems.
reputation: A recent benchmark suite that has been used in research on difficulty-aware evaluation, but it is not yet a broadly established standard.
notes: Difficulty scores assigned using Item Response Theory and Glicko-2 models based on human and LLM performance data; datasets have higher proportion of challenging problems.
